problem: The recursion for β(i, j, A) omits the probability of the rule A → B C. As written it multiplies only the children's inside probabilities, so β(1, n, S) would not equal the sentence probability defined two lines earlier, and the stated relation between the sum (β) and the max (δ) recurrences breaks down: δ includes × P(A → B C) but β does not.
fix: Write β(i, j, A) = Σ over rules A → B C and splits k from i to j−1 of P(A → B C) × β(i, k, B) × β(k + 1, j, C), with P(A → B C) the probability of the binary rule being expanded at that node.
